This application is a final year project designed to manage lab reservations efficiently. It allows students and staff to browse available labs, check real-time availability, and book slots for their academic needs.
How do I book a lab?
You can book a lab by selecting the desired lab card on the home dashboard, then choosing an available day and time slot.
Yes, you can cancel your bookings through the \'My Booking\' section in the side menu by clicking \'Clear All Bookings\'.
What are the lab operating hours?
Labs are typically open from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM on weekdays. Please refer to the specific lab\'s schedule for weekend availability.
Are there any specific lab rules?
Yes. No food or drinks are allowed inside. Users must leave the lab clean and ensure all equipment is turned off after use.
What should I do if the equipment is faulty?
Please report any faulty equipment immediately to the lab technician or through the \'Help & Support\' section.
How many bookings can I make per day?
Students are allowed a maximum of 2 active bookings per day to ensure fair access for everyone.
What if I need the lab for the whole day for an activity?
Whole-day bookings for special activities or events require administrative approval. Please visit the Lab Management Office to submit a formal request at least 3 days in advance.
